title: I've been developing a cozy voxel farming game for mobile called Farm Craft
author: imonedesign
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I've been working on **Farm Craft: Island Life**, a cozy mobile game where players can grow crops, build and decorate their own islands, raise animals, and go fishing.

I'm developing it in Godot, and one of my biggest goals has been making the world feel alive and relaxing while keeping the gameplay smooth on mobile.

The game is now available on [**Android**](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.realismmats.farmcraft), but I'm still working on improving it and adding more content.

I'd love to hear your feedback, especially on the visuals and gameplay. What would you improve or add?

comments.author: Embarrassed_Text_347
comments.body: I haven't tried it yet but by the looks of it I would try to differentiate yourself from Minecraft more. A lot of the textures look like they are identical copies of blocks in minecraft. Just my two cents. It would appeal a lot more if it had it's own unique art style.

replies.author: imonedesign
replies.body: Yes, I am already working on replacing all textures with new one that are more unique.

replies.author: imonedesign
replies.body: I am only showing the fishing part of the game here, I will post more gameplay soon.
